verdict.rationale: React is a JavaScript UI library for building components. A user-facing automation-rules engine (defining rules that fire actions on events) belongs to workflow or SaaS products, not to a UI rendering library, so this axis does not apply. React's event handlers and callbacks such as onUncaughtError are developer building blocks, not a rules-automation feature, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
